The table lists every atom of one conventional cubic cell of MOF-5 (Zn4O(BDC)3, COD 1516287) as fractional coordinates. Use the kinematic structure factor F(hkl) = Σ_j Z_j exp[2πi(h x_j + k y_j + l z_j)] with atomic numbers as angle-independent weights (C = 6, H = 1, O = 8, Zn = 30). Exactly one of the four reflections below has |F| = 0. Which one?

选项：
A. (2 2 0)
B. (1 1 0)
C. (2 0 0)
D. (3 3 1)
